entries.title: Large crowd causes Lake Shore Drive closure at 57th Street
entries.summary: <p>A portion of South DuSable Lake Shore Drive was closed Monday night after large crowds caused a heavy police presence in Jackson Park.</p><p>Traffic was closed around 9 p.m. on Lake Shore Drive at 57th Street, Chicago police said.</p><p>Around 1,000 people were seen gathered in the area, some jumping on top of cars. A few people in the crowd were seen throwing objects, and others charged toward a line of police officers.</p><p>No arrests were reported. The crowd size had dwindled by 10 p.m. </p><p>On Friday, University of Chicago Police issued an alert about a possible “teen takeover” gathering that had been planned for Monday night near 57th Street in that incident. </p><p>“I continue to call on parents and guardians to know where their children are and to help ensure they are safe and accounted for,” Mayor Brandon Johnson said after Sunday's
